description: O11: the REFUSAL of the rename verb on a static entity record when the new name already belongs to another record. The OutSystems.Model.Data.IRecord of SS11 (class ServiceStudio.Model.StaticRecord) does not publish Name: the name of the record is the writable property Identifier, and that is what rename writes (since 2026-10-03; before it refused with "IRecord 'Active' has no Name"). As in set Identifier, the kernel checks AbstractObject.NameClash before writing, because the native setter would add a suffix in SILENCE (Inactive -> Inactive2). The positive path, with the consumers rewritten and the contract checking Identifier, is in tests/jobs/rename-name-property.json; the same via set Identifier in tests/jobs/static-entity-lifecycle.json and set-identifier-clash.json. Measured with the base job:spec-data.
expectError: rename: 'Inactive' clashes with an existing name in that scope (the Studio would use 'Inactive2'); pick another name

ops._why: the name that already exists in the same scope: Identifier = Inactive.

ops.name: Inactive
ops._why: refused: the rename writes Identifier, and Inactive already belongs to another record of Status.
